weakness: Shared RMM support accounts; no account types, roles, approvals, or reviews; shared credentials not changed when a member left
source: P07 (AC-02 objectives; IA-05i.); P01 R-001, R-007; P03 G-018
remediation_plan: Remove both shared RMM accounts and rotate every RMM secret; named accounts only (POL-02 B.1); onboarding checklist with defined account types and roles; RMM rights scoped per customer; monthly reconciliation of every system and the colocation list (POL-02 B.9)
milestones: 2026-10-15 shared RMM accounts removed and secrets rotated; 2026-10-31 first monthly reconciliation; 2026-11-30 RMM rights scoped per customer
resources_required: Engineer time (about 16 hours); Operations Manager 1 hour a month

weakness: No MFA at the hypervisor manager and BMC layer; shared RMM MFA seed in the team vault; push MFA without number matching; no break-glass accounts
remediation_plan: Number matching on push MFA; hardware security keys for all 7 staff; named hypervisor manager accounts federated to the identity provider with MFA; BMCs reachable only from an MFA jump host; two offline break-glass accounts per critical system (POL-02 B.3, B.7)
milestones: 2026-10-15 number matching on; 2026-10-31 break-glass accounts sealed and stored; 2026-11-30 hardware keys issued; 2026-12-31 hypervisor manager and BMC MFA in place
resources_required: About $700 one-time (security keys); engineer time (about 24 hours)

weakness: Portal service account has full hypervisor administrator rights and a plain-text password; Owner uses standing administrator accounts; PSA vault readable by all staff
remediation_plan: Separate everyday and administrator accounts for the Owner; limit the portal service account to VM power, console, and provisioning actions and move its secret to the cloud secrets service; restrict vault folders by role and move bank server passwords to the password manager, then rotate them (POL-02 B.2, B.4)
milestones: 2026-10-31 Owner's separate accounts in use; 2026-11-30 portal role limited and secret moved; 2026-12-31 vault restricted and bank server passwords rotated
resources_required: About $600 a year (password manager tier); engineer time (about 20 hours)

weakness: One engineer can write, approve, and run an RMM script on every customer's servers; duties needing two people not defined
remediation_plan: Define the duties that need two people (POL-02 B.5, effective 2026-10-01); turn on the RMM approval workflow for scripts and policies aimed at more than one customer; require approval for MDR automation changes
milestones: 2026-10-01 POL-02 B.5 effective; 2026-11-30 RMM approval workflow on and tested
resources_required: Engineer time (about 6 hours); feature available in the current RMM license

weakness: RMM and cloud consoles accept sign-ins from any internet address; remote access types not documented
remediation_plan: Document allowed remote access types (POL-02 B.8, effective 2026-10-01); restrict RMM and cloud console sign-in to the company's VPN egress addresses
milestones: 2026-10-01 POL-02 B.8 effective; 2026-11-30 source-address restriction on both consoles

weakness: Cloud backup copy in the portal's account and not immutable; backup repository unencrypted; no DNS zone or PSA documentation export; no second approval for backup deletion
source: P07 (CP-09 objectives); P01 R-002, R-025; P04 finding 1
remediation_plan: Nightly DNS zone export to the backup copy; separate cloud account with 30-day object lock and an offline break-glass user; encrypted backup repository; two-person approval for deletion or retention changes; monthly PSA documentation export (POL-04 4.7)
milestones: 2026-10-31 nightly DNS zone export; 2026-11-30 monthly PSA export; 2026-12-31 separate account with object lock, encrypted repository, and deletion approval
resources_required: About $1,200 a year (separate backup account); engineer time (about 16 hours)

weakness: No contingency plan and no test; customer restores not recorded
remediation_plan: Quarterly recorded restore tests (one add-on VM, the portal database, one DNS zone); contingency plan from the BIA; degraded-mode recovery exercise into the cloud tenant before hurricane season
milestones: 2026-11-30 first recorded restore test; 2027-02-28 second test; 2027-03-31 contingency plan approved; 2027-05-31 site-loss exercise
resources_required: About $2,000 one-time (exercise); engineer time (about 8 hours a quarter)

weakness: Backup appliance kept its default password (new finding); BMC passwords weak, shared, and unchanged since 2022; no procedure for lost or compromised authenticators
source: P07 test 2026-08-18 (new finding); P01 R-024, R-003
remediation_plan: Change the appliance password (done 2026-08-19); sweep every DC-1 device for default passwords; unique BMC passwords per host with per-person checkout; written procedure for lost or compromised authenticators (POL-02 B.10)
milestones: 2026-08-19 appliance password changed; 2026-09-30 default-password sweep; 2026-11-30 unique BMC passwords vaulted; 2026-11-30 procedure written

weakness: Management plane not monitored: no hypervisor manager, BMC, RMM, cloud tenant, or DNS logs at the MDR; RMM misuse raised no alert in testing
remediation_plan: MDR add-on to ingest RMM, cloud tenant, hypervisor manager, and DNS logs with 12-month retention; alerts for multi-customer scripts, new-location sign-ins, and bulk deletions; first 60 days with no auto-close on new sources (P10)
milestones: 2026-11-30 RMM and cloud tenant logs onboarded; 2027-01-31 hypervisor manager and DNS logs onboarded and retention at 12 months

weakness: No review of management-plane logs or of alerts the MDR's AI closes; findings not reported to the Owner
remediation_plan: Weekly 30-minute log review checklist; monthly sample review of auto-closed alerts (P10 condition 2); monthly security report to the Owner (POL-02 A.10)
milestones: 2026-10-15 weekly review starts; 2026-10-31 first auto-close sample and first Owner report
resources_required: Lead Systems Engineer time (about 1 hour a week)

weakness: No reporting time rule known to staff; no valid bank designated contacts; executive fallback contacts not recorded
source: P07 interviews; P01 R-014; P03 G-003 to G-005, G-034
remediation_plan: Request and verify designated contacts from both banks; bank service register with CEO and CIO fallback contacts (POL-03 4.8); reporting rule card for every staff member; first tabletop with the MDR and a bank scenario
milestones: 2026-10-15 contacts requested in writing; 2026-10-28 tabletop; 2026-10-31 contacts verified and register complete
resources_required: Operations Manager time; MDR participation included in its contract

weakness: RMM and MDR providers never reviewed; RMM contract has no incident notice terms; MDR contract allows telemetry use for model training; no ongoing vendor monitoring
source: P07 (SA-09 objectives); P01 R-019, R-013; P03 G-029 to G-031
remediation_plan: Yearly review of each critical vendor (POL-02 A.5); obtain RMM and MDR SOC 2 reports; amend the RMM contract for 72-hour incident notice and the MDR contract to exclude the company's telemetry from model training
milestones: 2026-08-26 colocation SOC 2 report reviewed (P09); 2026-10-31 RMM and MDR reports requested; 2026-12-31 contract amendments signed
resources_required: Operations Manager time; counsel review of amendments

weakness: No termination checklist: VPN access stayed four months, colocation access five months, and shared secrets were not rotated; no exit reminder
remediation_plan: Last-day termination checklist covering every system, the colocation list, collection of devices and keys, rotation of known shared secrets, and a written confidentiality reminder (POL-02 B.6)
milestones: 2026-08-18 former employee removed from the colocation list; 2026-10-15 checklist in use
